blurb: Posh Pantry Kitchen offers cooking classes for adults, kids, and teens in Burnaby, BC. Most adult classes are 3-hour demonstration style with sampling and wine, while weekend workshops are more hands-on. They also host private events and kids birthday parties with various cooking class styles.
extraNote: All cooking class refunds are store credit except no credit within 72 hours of class start; may send someone else · Private event cancellations get store credit if more than 7 days notice, or refund less $75 fee; no refunds under 7 days
